fix: Per-frame Vec growth in layout. `SliverLayout` owns `children` by value, so the buffer cannot simply be hoisted without changing the RenderSliver layout API. At minimum pre-size it: `let mut children = Vec::with_capacity(self.children.len());` (lower bound, one child per lane). A reusable buffer would need `SliverLayout` to borrow or return the buffer to the caller; decide that together with the layout contract in system-design/ARCHITECTURE.md.
